minutes.headline: Cable committee voted to let the manager seek a capital warrant article for the Nov special town meeting, and began reviewing its charter.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee approved July and August minutes, heard the manager's report on YouTube streaming and copyright problems, hiring, football coverage and finances, then spent most of the meeting marking up its 2014 membership booklet and mission statement. It also discovered its capital line shows zero and moved to put a capital request in the warrant for the fall special town meeting. No charter changes were voted.
